title: An Initial Review if the App
body:
I have installed the Finch App based on my 13yo daughter recommendation, who is using it with her friends. 

When I saw the design and features, I asked my daughter whether I can also try it. She agreed…. 

So after 3 days, I can say that this is a State of the Art Application! 

With the well designed User Interface (UI), very advanced and modern middleware and backend logic. 

I guess, the system is adaptable and user group tailored with AI iad. 

Great work, guys! 

Thank You👍🙂
Vladimir
